text: I hit the monthly export limit again on the 9th. There is no way to see how close I am until it stops working, and then I have to wait until the first of the month. I would pay for more if the upgrade page actually said what the new limit would be.
The invoice for March lists two line items I do not recognise and the totals do not add up to what was charged to the card. I need a corrected invoice for our finance team by the end of the week.
The mobile app logs me out every few days and I have to go through the whole sign-in flow again. On my laptop it stays signed in for months. Same account, same password.
I asked about a broken import on Monday and got the first reply on Thursday. Four days for a one-line answer is a long time when the import is blocking the whole team. Is there a faster queue?
Trying to connect our warehouse through the API. The docs describe a field called owner_ref that the endpoint rejects as unknown. Either the docs are stale or the endpoint is. Which one?
Every third page has a banner asking me to upgrade. I understand you need to sell the paid plan but it now covers the button I am trying to press on the settings page. It is genuinely in the way.

The new navigation moved Reports under a menu that is only visible once you scroll. Three people on my team could not find it and assumed the feature had been removed. Please put it back where it was.
We are being billed for eleven seats but only seven people have ever logged in. I removed four accounts last quarter and the seat count never went down. Can someone look at this before the renewal?
Upload fails silently on files over about 20 MB. No error, no progress, the dialog just closes. Smaller files are fine. Chrome on Windows, latest version.
I would like to get our data out in a form we can keep — the CSV export only covers the last ninety days and drops the attachments entirely. Is there a full export anywhere?
The free plan caps at three projects and we have four teams. I am not asking you to raise the cap, I am asking you to say so on the pricing page instead of after I have set everything up.
Support asked me to reproduce the problem and send a screen recording, which I did nine days ago. Since then, nothing. I am not sure the ticket is still open.
The webhook fires twice for a single event about one time in twenty. We have had to add our own deduplication. Happy to send request IDs if that helps.
Dark mode is unreadable on the comparison screen — grey text on a slightly different grey. I have gone back to the light theme, which defeats the point of having a dark one.
Card was declined on renewal and the account went read-only within the hour, with no warning email first. A grace period of even a day would have saved a lot of scrambling.
Advertising for the paid tiers now appears inside the export dialog itself. I am trying to do a piece of work and being sold to in the middle of it.
Our single sign-on integration breaks whenever someone changes their surname in the directory. It creates a second account rather than updating the first. We now have a dozen duplicates.
Search returns results in what looks like random order. Sorting by date is the only option and it is not what I want. A relevance sort would make the feature usable.
The API rate limit on the free plan is fifty calls an hour, which the documentation does not mention anywhere. I only found out from the error code. Please document the limits.
We need the invoices to carry our VAT number and a purchase order reference. Right now they carry neither and our accounts department rejects them every month.
Keyboard focus is invisible in the editor — tabbing moves the cursor somewhere but nothing on screen shows where. This makes the editor unusable without a mouse.
I waited on chat for fifty minutes and then the session ended by itself. The transcript was not emailed to me, so I have nothing to refer back to and will have to start again.
Is there a way to pipe events into our own data warehouse without polling? We are on the business plan and polling every minute is wasteful for both of us.
Notifications arrive about twenty minutes late, sometimes an hour. By the time I see one the thing it is telling me about has usually been handled by someone else.
